meta.project: Hi Line Pro Care Store Backend API

product_overview: A backend API for the Hi Line Pro Care store that supports public browsing, order placement, and order tracking. It also provides protected admin capabilities for authentication, order management, and product management.
core_goals: Allow customers to browse active products and place orders through public APIs.
Enable customers to track and cancel orders using order number-based endpoints.
Provide secure admin authentication and protected management of orders and products.
Handle invalid input, duplicate submissions, stock constraints, and unauthorized access safely.

features.name: Store API (Public)
features.description: Public endpoints let customers browse available products, place new orders, check order status, and cancel orders without authentication.
user_flows: POST /api/trpc/store.getProducts with a valid request -> Receive 200 with a list of active products
POST /api/trpc/store.getProducts with malformed payload or invalid data types -> Receive 400 with validation error

POST /api/trpc/store.placeOrder with valid customer and cart details -> Receive 200 with order confirmation and order number -> POST /api/trpc/store.getOrderByNumber with the returned order number -> Receive 200 with order status details
POST /api/trpc/store.placeOrder with missing payload, negative quantities, or out-of-stock items -> Receive 400 with validation or inventory error
POST /api/trpc/store.placeOrder with a duplicate request payload -> Receive 200 or 409 indicating duplicate prevention or existing order handling
POST /api/trpc/store.cancelOrder with a valid order number and cancelable order state -> Receive 200 with cancellation confirmation
POST /api/trpc/store.cancelOrder with an invalid order number or non-cancelable state -> Receive 404 or 400 with an error message
POST /api/trpc/store.getOrderByNumber with a valid order number -> Receive 200 with order status details
POST /api/trpc/store.getOrderByNumber with an invalid slug/number format or SQL injection attempt -> Receive 400 with validation error

features.name: Admin API (Protected)
features.description: Protected endpoints support admin login and authenticated management of orders and products.
user_flows: POST /api/trpc/auth.login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with authentication token or session context -> POST /api/trpc/admin.listOrders with valid auth -> Receive 200 with order list -> POST /api/trpc/admin.updateOrderStatus with an order ID and new status -> Receive 200 with updated order status
POST /api/trpc/auth.login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with authentication error
POST /api/trpc/admin.listOrders without authentication -> Receive 401 or 403 unauthorized access error
POST /api/trpc/admin.updateOrderStatus with valid auth and valid order data -> Receive 200 with updated order status
POST /api/trpc/admin.updateOrderStatus with missing payload, invalid data types, or invalid status value -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/trpc/admin.listProducts with valid auth -> Receive 200 with product list
POST /api/trpc/admin.createProduct with valid auth and complete product data -> Receive 200 with created product details
POST /api/trpc/admin.createProduct with large payload, missing fields, or invalid types -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/trpc/admin.updateProduct with valid auth and existing product data -> Receive 200 with updated product details
POST /api/trpc/admin.deleteProduct with valid auth and existing product identifier -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation
POST /api/trpc/admin.deleteOrder with valid auth and existing order identifier -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation
POST /api/trpc/admin.deleteOrder without authentication -> Receive 401 or 403 unauthorized access error
